question: I want to create a web-based ai-agent orchestrator + catalog of agents something similar to what openai has built, probably custom-gpt. It's a B2C orchestrator where anyone can create their own agent. Now, when someone is creating an agent, what they can do is define a persona of that particular agent, and after that they can define what all connectors it can connect to. It could be MCP connectors. It could be token-based connectors, like it could connect to Gmail, it could connect to Slack, and then divide what all information is present in these places and use it for reasoning and sending information. it can connect to Rag databases and others. Additionally, it can have its skills using the claude skills syntax with scripts that can run in the skills and all of that. Additionally, it can have memory layer as well to store different sorts of memory data. So when you are building this or deep diving into this, use a mermaid diagram to elaborate on how all the different components + agents + memory (deep-diving memory) interact with each other.
